# Lume

> Daily glow coach for iPhone. One photo. A score. A sixty-second ritual.

Lume reads a photo on the device, scores glow, evenness, texture, and calm, and writes a morning and evening ritual that stays at sixty seconds. Photos are not uploaded. It is a coaching tool, not a medical device.

- Site: https://lumenow.app/
- Support: mailto:support@lumenow.app
- Press: mailto:hello@lumenow.app
- Privacy: https://lumenow.app/privacy.html
- Terms: https://lumenow.app/terms.html
- App Store: coming soon

## Product
- On-device glow score from one photo
- Sixty-second morning and evening ritual
- Fourteen-day trend
- iPhone and iPhone Duo (face on one screen, ritual on the other)
- No account. No ad tracking.

## Pricing
- $39.99 / year with a 7-day free trial
- $7.99 / week with a 7-day free trial
- Cancel in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions
